chunks.arabic_text: رَبِيعُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّا، الْوَرَّاقُ، كُوفِيٌّ. ضَعِيفٌ.

translations.en: Rabiʿ ibn Zakariyya, al-Warrāq (the papermaker), Kufan. Weak.

en.summary: This entry from al-Ghada'iri's *Kitab al-Duafa* identifies Rabiʿ ibn Zakariyya, known as al-Warrāq (the papermaker), as a Kufan narrator of moderate reliability whose weakness is noted in the context of early hadith transmission. His designation highlights the meticulous scrutiny applied to narrators in Kufa, where the proliferation of written materials and scholarly circles required rigorous verification of individual credibility to preserve the integrity of the Prophetic tradition.
en.seo_question: Who is Rabiʿ ibn Zakariyya al-Warrāq and what is his status in hadith sciences?

key_terms.رَبِيعُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّا: Rabiʿ ibn Zakariyya, the narrator's name
key_terms.الْوَرَّاقُ: al-Warrāq, a kunya meaning the papermaker or scribe
key_terms.كُوفِيٌّ: Kufan, indicating origin from the city of Kufah
key_terms.ضَعِيفٌ: Weak, a technical term in ʿilm al-rijāl denoting a narrator of lesser reliability
